complaint: Equifax is reporting a delinquent collection account of $1,450 from an unknown medical provider that does not belong to me. I suspect identity theft and disputed this 45 days ago with no response.
admin_notes: Formal FCRA 30-day investigation notice issued to Credit Reporting Bureau. Flagged for immediate compliance triage.

complaint: Someone used my credit card without my permission to purchase $850 worth of electronics online and my account was debited immediately.
admin_notes: Card frozen immediately. Provisional credit of $850 credited to cardholder account. Chargeback initiated with acquiring merchant.

complaint: A third-party debt collector keeps calling my workplace 5 times a day demanding payment for a credit card debt that was already paid off in 2021. They threatened wage garnishment.
admin_notes: FDCPA violation investigation initiated. Cease-and-desist communication notice dispatched to collection agency.

complaint: I made my monthly mortgage payment of $2,100 on time, but the servicer misapplied the funds into escrow instead of principal, and assessed an improper late fee of $120.
admin_notes: Mortgage servicer corrected ledger allocation to principal & interest. Late charge of $120 reversed and credited.

complaint: I initiated an international wire transfer of $3,500 via SWIFT for urgent family medical expenses 8 days ago. The funds have left my account but never arrived at the beneficiary bank.
admin_notes: Wire tracking trace ticket opened with intermediary clearing bank. High-urgency wire recall inquiry pending.

complaint: My bank charged four consecutive overdraft fees of $35 each on the same day due to an internal system batch processing reordering of debit transactions.
admin_notes: Reviewed transaction posting order. Courtesy refund of $140 credited back to customer checking account.

complaint: My student loan servicer failed to certify my Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) payment count despite 120 qualifying on-time payments made over 10 years.
admin_notes: Escalated to Federal Student Aid ombudsman unit for payment history audit and discharge verification.

complaint: I received a notice threatening repossession of my vehicle even though my monthly auto lease payment of $420 was debited directly via auto-pay on the 1st of this month.
admin_notes: URGENT ESCALATION: Auto repossession hold confirmed with recovery operations. Payment trace located and reconciled.

complaint: My debit card was swallowed by an ATM machine at a local branch during an error and $300 cash was not dispensed but deducted from my balance.
admin_notes: ATM cash cassette count requested from cash-in-transit vendor. Provisional credit of $300 issued.

complaint: I applied for a credit limit increase on my card 3 weeks ago. Can you explain the status and documentation required for underwriting review?
admin_notes: Provided underwriting status update and secure portal link for submitting updated proof of income.
